title: Maximum Givens in Minimal Sudoku
exact_target: What is the largest number of givens that a standard 9 by 9 Sudoku can have while every individual given is essential to its unique solution?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1360 (GAME-003). CC BY 4.0.

Gary McGuire, Bastian Tugemann and Gilles Civario, \emph{There is no 16-Clue Sudoku: Solving the Sudoku Minimum Number of Clues Problem via Hitting Set Enumeration} (2013), arXiv:1201.0749v2, Section 1 (Sudoku rules and unique completion), and Section 5.1 (clue sets and unavoidable sets).
